# Dynamic loader bookkeeping from dlopen() (triggered whenever CPython
# imports a C extension) is kept alive for the process lifetime by design --
# not a real leak. Keep this list narrow: CEA allocates via plain libc
# malloc/free, so broader suppressions (e.g. PyImport_*, pymalloc) risk
# masking a real leak instead of just this known false positive.
leak:dl_open
leak:_dl_open
leak:dlopen
